stem:
Kavya has a paper square with a design on it. She wants to know whether the design has mathematical symmetry.

Which check decides that?

options.text: The design looks attractive, so it is symmetric.
The design has matching colours, so it is symmetric.
A fold or a turn maps the design onto itself.
A definite pattern of matching parts is what creates symmetry by itself.

teacher.key_rationale: Symmetry requires a fold or rotation that maps the figure onto itself. Attractiveness and colour alone do not. Matching parts do not create the transformation; the transformation shows the match.
